# M/s Endorys (ENDORYS™)

> Bengaluru-based medical-device and acoustic metrology research initiative developing conformable quantitative ultrasound architectures, impedance-matched acoustic coupling (~1.50 MRayl), and closed-loop Coupling Quality Index (CQI) gating for repeatable tissue and non-destructive testing (NDT) measurements.

## Core Identifiers & Intellectual Property
- **Legal Entity:** M/s Endorys (Micro Enterprise, Udyam Registration: `UDYAM-KR-03-0786660`, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India)
- **Founder & Principal Inventor:** Sadhu Shobab Bollipo ([ORCID: 0009-0006-7846-7884](https://orcid.org))
- **Patent Status:** Patent Pending — Indian Provisional Patent Application No. `202641134091` (Priority Date: 07 November 2026)
- **Open-Science Benchmark Archive:** [Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24555614](https://doi.org)
- **Open-Source Reference Repository:** [://github.com](https://://github.com) (Apache-2.0 software / CC-BY-4.0 docs; hardware & closed-loop CQI gating patent rights reserved)

## Site Map & Technical Resources
- [Home (`endorys.com`)](https://endorys.com/): Core measurement challenge, 3-layer platform architecture (Endorys Matrix, Controlled Acquisition, Endorys Insight), and Protocol E001 overview.
- [Interactive CQI Simulator (`check.html`)](https://endorys.com/check.html): Multi-parameter 1.7 MHz curved-surface acoustic coupling simulator, Clinical Repeatability (CV%) ROI estimator, and client-side CSV waveform auditor.
- [Technology (`technology.html`)](https://endorys.com): Conformal sensing geometry, coupling drift suppression, and path qualification methodology.
- [Applications (`applications.html`)](https://endorys.com): Quantitative tissue characterization and curved-surface industrial non-destructive testing (NDT) research tracks.
- [Research Library (`research-library.html`)](https://endorys.com): Twelve structured research workstreams, Protocol E001 validation gates, and selective openness policy.
- [Venture Overview (`overview.html`)](https://endorys.com): Governance, IP posture, and collaboration framework.
